hero.title: Flavor Knowledge Base
hero.intro: Look up a food or a flavor compound: which compounds create a food's aroma, which foods a compound occurs in, and related research papers. Data are grouped into three tiers by strength of evidence.
legend.title: Evidence tiers
legend.t1k_desc: From the main text of the review by Dunkel et al. (2014): compounds confirmed by GC-O, quantitation and recombination experiments to contribute to the food's aroma.
legend.t1d_desc: From the FlavorDB database: the compound has been detected in the food. Detection does not mean it contributes to the aroma.
legend.t2_desc: Related papers retrieved live from Europe PMC when you open a page. Listed only, not summarized.
legend.t3_desc: Fetches the abstract for a DOI you enter and marks the flavor compound names it contains. Text matching only, not the paper's conclusions.
search.title: Search by food or compound
search.label: Food or compound name
search.none: No food or compound matches "{q}". Try a shorter keyword.
search.load_failed: The knowledge base could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
food.kfo_complete: According to the review, the aroma of this food is created by these compounds alone.
food.detected_note: Compounds FlavorDB lists as detected in this food; most of them do not affect the aroma.
cmp.no_kfo: The main text of Dunkel 2014 does not name this compound as a key food odorant of a specific food.
cmp.predict: See the graph neural network's odor prediction for this compound
doi.title: DOI abstract analysis
doi.label: Paper DOI
doi.bad: This is not a valid DOI. A DOI starts with "10.", for example 10.1002/anie.201309508.
doi.not_found: This DOI was not found in Europe PMC or Crossref.
doi.failed: The literature databases cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.
doi.no_abstract: The paper was found, but no abstract is available in the public databases, so it cannot be analyzed.
doi.matches: Flavor compounds mentioned in the abstract ({n})
doi.no_matches: No flavor compound from the knowledge base was found in the abstract.
doi.disclaimer: Abstract only, based on text matching, not the paper's conclusions. Compounds written differently (abbreviations, trade names) may be missed.
footer.data: Data: key food odorants quoted from the main text of Dunkel A, et al. Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2014, 53, 7124-7143 (doi:10.1002/anie.201309508) with page numbers; the full food by odorant matrix is in that article's Supporting Information. Detection data from FlavorDB2 (Garg N, et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2018), CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; derived data on this site are shared under the same license. Compound names and structures from PubChem.
footer.apis: Literature services: Europe PMC and Crossref (free, no API key).
hero.sub: Key aroma compounds, detected compounds and papers, by food or compound.
footer.short: Key food odorants from Dunkel et al. 2014; detection data from FlavorDB2 (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, derived data shared alike); papers via Europe PMC and Crossref. See method & sources.
